_readme: Every setting for the ticker app. Edit, then reload it WITHOUT recompiling:
Any key may be left out -- the firmware default applies. A value outside
its allowed range is REJECTED and named on the serial log, not silently
clamped, so a typo tells you about itself instead of quietly half-working.
Logo size is NOT here: it is fixed at 96px because the firmware and
tools/make-logos.py have to agree on it. Wi-Fi credentials are not here
either, and deliberately so -- see SECURITY.md.
_brightness: Backlight duty, 8-255. The ONE dial that measurably moves power on this
board: measured steady-state die temperature is 45.1C at 140, 43.5 at 100,
40.5 at 60 and 37.1 at 0, so the panel is worth ~8C and the SoC alone
floors at 37C. Duty is proportional to LED current, so lowering it saves
real power even where the die sensor barely moves.
'closed' is the cheap win: stock rows do not change between the close and
the next open, or at all at weekends. 'night' uses the window below.
The floor is 8 rather than 0 because 0 reads as a dead board.
_night: Hours (0-23) for the night brightness. Shared with ui.h.
_layout: Which layout to start in: 'list' (six rows, paging) or 'solo' (one symbol
filling the screen with its logo). This is only a STARTING POINT -- a 2s
hold on the button switches layout and that choice is stored in NVS, which
then wins over this key. The boot log says which is in effect.
_timing: pageSeconds  how long each page of six rows stays up before the next.
soloSeconds  how long one symbol holds the screen in solo layout. 2-600.
cascadeMs    per-row stagger when a page flips, 0-400. Set 0 for an
instant flip; 22 reads as movement and costs nothing extra.
_refresh: Minutes between price refreshes. Stocks cost one HTTPS request EACH and
are swept one per loop pass, so a 22-stock sweep takes about 30s whatever
this says. Measured: 22 requests 0.3s apart drew zero 429s from Yahoo, so
there is room here -- but nothing is fetched at all while the screen is
blanked, which saves more than any interval.
openMinutes    while the market is open, 1-240.
closedMinutes  while it is shut, 1-1440. Hourly is plenty.
coinMinutes    crypto, 1-240. One cheap request for all coins, and it
never closes, so this stays live overnight.
_timezone: POSIX TZ string, used for the clock AND for the market window below.
Default is US Eastern, which is where the listed exchanges are.
_market: Trading window as HH:MM, evaluated in the timezone above, Mon-Fri. It
drives both the open/closed brightness and the refresh interval. Change
the timezone and you must move these too -- that coupling is why they are
settings rather than a buried constant. An inverted window is rejected.
_symbols: Six rows show at once -- what fits at text size 2, and size 1 is already
known to be too small to read on this panel. A longer list pages through
six at a time. 32 symbols maximum, labels capped at 5 characters because
that is the width of the symbol box.
coins   CoinGecko ids (the id, not the ticker); all of them travel in a
single request, so they are nearly free. Find an id at
The logo fetcher looks coins up by LABEL, which has to be a real
ticker for a logo to be found.
